evaluation_acceleration: Group independent origins by native per-origin FFT period; unchanged training, architecture, randomization and calibration; equivalent to separate-origin inference up to floating-point reduction roundoff
status: NEW supplemental experiments; no claim to reconstruct historical separate-host results
normalization: per-asset mean and population SD fitted to unique raw training rows including purged training labels only
selection: uncalibrated validation ES on all 500 exact fold 2 origins after every epoch; identical initialization/shuffle seed perLR; no test-outcome use in training, selection or calibration
mean_calibration: after checkpoint/candidate selection; rho in[.05,1] selected by validation ES with frozen centered-training-residual innovations; exact empirical-adapter predictive mean from backbone, not sample mean
inputs: 126 historical excess log returns for all32 assets; no FF5 values, volume, concepts, graphs or future calendar covariates; differs from TREFIN concept/factor/volume predictors
adapter: PyPOTS maintained TimeMixer++ implementation, not an official-author-source reproduction; unchanged forecast/backbone/layers; three exact scales126/42/14; two32-width mixer blocks with64-width FF/inception channels, top3 periods,3 kernels, channel mixing and independence, native RevIN; preserves upstream final/coarsest prediction head. Because native FFT period selection averages its batch, evaluation selects periods independently per origin and groups equal-period convolution/attention branches across origins without mixing information; training retains shuffled minibatches.
scenarios: whole[5,32] centered training residual paths sampled with replacement, same adapter as fresh Timer-XL; point model itself is not natively probabilistic
training: pointMSE; Adam(.9,.999), no weight decay; epoch cosine scheduler to1e-8; gradclip1;100full-data epochs cap,15validation-check patience

numerical_acceptance.decision: accept grouped independent-origin evaluation at outer batch32; training remains batch64
numerical_acceptance.decision_scope: Numerical implementation equivalence, not a forecasting-performance or significance result; decided before full optimized training and test evaluation
numerical_acceptance.additional_requirements: finite outputs; exact training losses/gradients; identical tested FFT top-k membership and rank
numerical_acceptance.TF32: disabled for matmul and cuDNN in both runner and diagnostic
numerical_acceptance.interpretation: Batch1 outputs are exact. Grouped CUDA differences start in finer-scale block outputs, with exact coarse FFT inputs/scores/selections; consistent with batch-shape-dependent float32 kernel roundoff. The fitted forecast RMS-relative discrepancy is about0.00295%, and maximum discrepancy is0.00617basispoints. This is not a bitwise-CUDA-equivalence claim or a guarantee for every possible input.
numerical_acceptance.rationale: Retain raw-return tolerance0.01basispoint as the primary observable-unit criterion, add normalized maximum and RMS-relative guards1e-4; the original2e-5 normalized guard was more restrictive than this documented implementation-agreement criterion. No model hyperparameter, data split, fitting objective, calibration rule or test outcome informed this numerical decision.
